## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Verified:** the change fixes the data loss in #12927. A user's own `~/.config/fontconfig/fonts.conf` is now left byte-identical, and the chosen font is still first for `monospace`. One gap remains: a generated `fonts.conf` that the user has since edited is kept, so it silently overrides every later `omarchy font set`.

**Verified** with fontconfig 2.18.3 (the reporter's version), using a synthetic configuration:

| Starting `~/.config/fontconfig` | Base | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| User `fonts.conf` with its own rgba rule | rule deleted, chosen font first | file unchanged, chosen font first |
| Untouched `fonts.conf` from an earlier `font set` | rewritten, chosen font first | file removed, drop-in used, chosen font first |
| Generated `fonts.conf` plus a user edit | edit deleted, chosen font first | file kept, **old font first** |

- **Load order:** `50-user.conf` includes `~/.config/fontconfig/conf.d` before `fonts.conf`, so the order is package `50-omarchy.conf`, then the new drop-in, then the user's `fonts.conf`. A user's own rules now apply after Omarchy's.
- **Second commit:** with only the first commit, an untouched generated `fonts.conf` keeps its old font ahead of the drop-in. Removing that file when it matches the template, ignoring the font name, is what makes the new font take effect.
- **Added test:** `test/shell.d/font-set-test.sh` passes on this head and fails on the base (truncation assertion) and on the first commit alone (removal assertion). Its legacy fixture matches what the base script actually generates.

### An edited generated `fonts.conf` overrides later font changes

The removal in `bin/omarchy-font-set` needs the whole file to match the template after masking the font name. If the 4.0.x-generated `prepend_first` block is still in `fonts.conf` alongside anything else (another `<match>` rule, a comment, or even one trailing blank line), the file is kept, as the code comment intends. That block then runs after the drop-in and puts its old family back in first place:

```text
50-omarchy.conf                 assign monospace -> JetBrainsMono Nerd Font
conf.d/50-omarchy-monospace     prepend_first    -> CaskaydiaMono Nerd Font   (requested)
fonts.conf (generated + edit)   prepend_first    -> OldFont Mono              (kept)

monospace: "OldFont Mono", "CaskaydiaMono Nerd Font", "JetBrainsMono Nerd Font", ...
```

(Synthetic font names. Family list from `fc-pattern -c monospace`, with no fonts installed.)

**Impact:** `omarchy font set`, from the CLI or the font menu, exits 0 without a warning and switches the terminal configs, but the fontconfig `monospace` family does not change. The Omarchy shell, Qt apps, `omarchy font current` and the menu's current-font marker keep the old font. Before this PR, the same user lost their edits but got the new font. The users most likely to reach this state are those who keep their own rules in `fonts.conf`, the group #12927 is about.

**Suggested change:** remove only the generated `<match>` block (with any font name) from `fonts.conf` and keep the rest of the file, as #12927 suggests, optionally with a backup. At minimum, warn when `fonts.conf` still holds a `prepend_first` rule for `monospace` after the drop-in is written. A test case with "generated block plus a user rule" would cover this state.

**Stale comment:** `shell/Commons/Style.qml` (around line 460) still says `omarchy font set` rewrites `~/.config/fontconfig/fonts.conf`, and its `FileView` watches only that path. `font set` restarts the shell, so the font change still applies. A manual edit to the new drop-in will not trigger a live re-resolve.

**PR description:** it says the user's `fonts.conf` "is left completely alone". The second commit deletes an untouched generated copy, which is worth stating.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Source review of this PR, the base, `omarchy-upgrade-to-quattro` and the font readers, plus fontconfig 2.18.3's include order and `assign`/`prepend_first` handling. Isolated runs used a synthetic fontconfig 2.18.3 configuration with stubbed Omarchy commands and no installed fonts, and compared family lists from `fc-pattern`. Not tested: a live desktop session, real installed fonts through `fc-match`, and other fontconfig versions.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, independent Opus 5.5 Xhigh and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh technical assessments, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.
